title.en: Nato condemns Russian 'recklessness' after drone hits Romanian residential block
title.zh: 北约谴责俄罗斯“鲁莽行为”，无人机击中罗马尼亚居民区

summary.en: Romania is set to convene an emergency meeting after a drone struck a residential block, injuring two people. NATO has condemned the incident, attributing it to Russian 'recklessness'.
summary.zh: 一架无人机击中罗马尼亚一居民区，造成两人受伤，罗马尼亚将召开紧急会议。北约谴责此次事件是俄罗斯的“鲁莽行为”。

body.en:
A Russian drone has hit a block of flats in Romania, causing a fire and injuring two people, Romanian officials say.

Friday's incident in the eastern town of Galați, near Romania's border with Ukraine, was harshly criticised by Nato and the EU, which rallied to the support the fellow member.

Nato's secretary general said "Russia's reckless behaviour is a danger to us all", while the head of the European Commission said Moscow's "war of aggression had crossed yet another line".

Russian drones have strayed across Romania's border a number of times during the four-year war with Ukraine, but it is the first time Romanians have been hurt.

At a news briefing, Vladimir Putin said he had only just heard of the incident, suggesting that the drone wreckage should be handed over to Russia for an "objective investigation".

He also recalled recent cases of Ukrainian drones straying into a number of EU countries.

Romania's emergency situations authority said the drone's entire explosive payload detonated and caused a fire on the 10th floor of the residential building.

Two people with abrasions required medical treatment and were taken to the Galați County Emergency Clinical Hospital. About 70 people were evacuated as the fire was put out.

Romania's defence ministry said two F-16 fighter jets were scrambled after the drones were detected. Brig Gen Gheorghe Maxim said the army had only had four minutes from when the drone was detected to the moment of impact.

The ministry added in a later update that it appeared the "entire load" of the Geran 2 drone - also known as a Shahed 136 - had exploded on impact.

Gen Maxim said Romanian forces were under significant constraints, as they could not fire munitions that violated Ukrainian airspace. "Ukraine is at war, but Romania is at peace. We cannot launch a projectile into Ukrainian airspace," he said.

Romania's military has sought to reassure the public that it was not an attack on the country but rather "a conflict at our border, with consequences for the local population".

Speaking during a visit to Galați later on Friday, Romanian President Nicușor Dan said the drone that struck the residential building in his country was likely hit while still being over Ukraine, apparently by Ukraine's air defences.

"There was a group of 43 drones coming from the east. Some were shot down over Ukraine, and one was hit above the [Ukrainian] city of Reni, which altered its trajectory."

Dan also said his administration would expel the Russian consul in the Black Sea port of Constanța and shut down the consulate. Moscow said it "won't take long" to respond.

President Dan also convened an emergency meeting of Romania's Supreme Defence Council, describing the Russian drone strike as "the most serious incident to have affected...
body.zh: 罗马尼亚官员称，一架俄罗斯无人机击中了罗马尼亚的一栋公寓，引发火灾并造成两人受伤。 周五在罗马尼亚与乌克兰边境附近的东部城镇加拉茨发生的事件遭到北约和欧盟的严厉批评，欧盟和北约组织联合起来支持这位成员国。 北约秘书长表示，“俄罗斯的鲁莽行为对我们所有人构成危险”​​，而欧盟委员会主席则表示，莫斯科的“侵略战争已经越过了另一道底线”。 在与乌克兰的四年战争中，俄罗斯无人机多次越过罗马尼亚边境，但这是罗马尼亚人第一次受到伤害。 普京在新闻发布会上表示，他刚刚听说这起事件，并建议将无人机残骸移交给俄罗斯进行“客观调查”。 他还回顾了最近乌克兰无人机误入多个欧盟国家的案例。 罗马尼亚紧急情况当局表示，无人机的整个爆炸物有效载荷引爆，并导致住宅楼 10 楼起火。 两名擦伤者需要治疗，并被送往加拉茨县紧急临床医院。大火被扑灭后，约70人被疏散。 罗马尼亚国防部表示，在发现无人机后，两架 F-16 战斗机紧急紧急升空。格奥尔基·马克西姆准将表示，从检测到无人机到撞击的那一刻，军队只有四分钟的时间。 该部在后来的更新中补充说，Geran 2 无人机（也称为 Shahed 136）的“全部负载”似乎在撞击时爆炸了。 马克西姆将军表示，罗马尼亚军队受到严重限制，因为他们无法发射侵犯乌克兰领空的弹药。 “乌克兰处于战争状态，但罗马尼亚处于和平状态。我们不能向乌克兰领空发射射弹，”他说。 罗马尼亚军方试图向公众保证，这不是针对该国的袭击，而是“我们边境的冲突，给当地居民带来了后果”。 周五晚些时候，罗马尼亚总统尼库索尔·丹在访问加拉茨时表示，袭击该国住宅楼的无人机很可能是在乌克兰上空被击中的，显然是被乌克兰防空系统击中的。 “有 43 架无人机从东部飞来。其中一些在乌克兰上空被击落，一架在[乌克兰]雷尼市上空被击中，导致其飞行轨迹发生改变。” 丹还表示，他的政府将驱逐俄罗斯驻黑海港口康斯坦察领事馆，并关闭该领事馆。莫斯科表示“不会花很长时间”做出回应。 丹总统还召开了罗马尼亚最高国防委员会紧急会议，将俄罗斯无人机袭击描述为“影响……的最严重事件”。

verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚2026年大选：提格雷地区被排除在外，局势紧张

summary.en: As Ethiopia prepares for its upcoming elections, the Tigray region will not participate for the second consecutive time, leading to continued tensions. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and his Prosperity Party are widely expected to secure a victory.
summary.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚准备举行大选，提格雷地区将第二次不参与投票，导致紧张局势持续。与此同时，预计总理阿比·艾哈迈德及其繁荣党将赢得选举。

body.en:
As Ethiopia is heading to the polls, the Tigray region won't be participating in the vote for the second time, with tensions simmering on. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and his Prosperity Party meanwhile are expected to win.

There is not a single delegate in Ethiopia's outgoing lower house of parliament, known as the House of Peoples' Representatives, nor in the upper house — the House of Federation — currently representing the embattled Tigray region.

Missing out on another election in 2026 will bring Tigray's total absence from the political arena in Addis Ababa to a full decade. Many wonder where this leaves the region, as tensions appear to flare up again.

"Can we still say with certainty that 'Tigray is part of Ethiopia ?' I am not sure," says Alemayehu Fentaw, a fellow at the Center for Constitutional Democracy at the Indiana University Maurer School of Law.

Others seem to share a similarly despondent view of the situation — or worse.

Ethiopia's federal government is legally mandated to ensure and facilitate the representation of Tigray in its federal institutions, including the two chambers, as per the agreement signed following AU-led mediation in Pretoria in 2022.

However, that agreement has repeatedly failed to live up to expectations, other than  largely succeeding in silencing active fighting in the region ; above all, it has not helped bring democracy back to Tigray. 

"More than 40% of the sovereign territory of Tigray is under enemy control," says  Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF)  spokesman Michaele Asgedom, highlighting that the region is unable "to conduct an election" after years of conflict.

Asgedom explains that millions of internally displaced people who had fled from Tigray  due to the bloody civil war   have not returned home, in addition to countless people who had originally sought refuge in neighboring   Sudan ; any election held in Tigray would therefore not be representative of all Tigrayans, he tells DW.

But there's more than a disparate electorate that has observers worrying about the fragile peace in the region, as the rest of the country prepares to go to the polls: The 2020 to 2022 Tigray war still casts its long shadow.

In 2020, Ethiopia's government under Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed had to postpone the country's planned elections due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

The TPLF — the largest and most dominant party in the country's northern Tigray region — accused Abiy of  unconstitutionally extending his government's term this way, and went on to arrange its own local elections, which it won.

body.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚即将举行投票，提格雷地区将不会第二次参加投票，紧张局势仍在持续。与此同时，总理阿比·艾哈迈德和他的繁荣党预计将获胜。 埃塞俄比亚即将卸任的议会下议院（即人民代表院）和上议院（联邦议院）目前都没有一名代表代表陷入困境的提格雷地区。 如果错过 2026 年的另一次选举，蒂格雷将彻底缺席亚的斯亚贝巴的政治舞台整整十年。随着紧张局势似乎再次加剧，许多人想知道这会给该地区带来什么影响。 “我们还能肯定地说‘提格雷是埃塞俄比亚的一部分吗？’ 我不确定，”印第安纳大学毛雷尔法学院宪政民主中心研究员阿莱马耶胡·芬托 (Alemayehu Fentaw) 说。 其他人似乎对这种情况也有同样的沮丧看法——或者更糟。 根据 2022 年非盟主导的比勒陀利亚调解后签署的协议，埃塞俄比亚联邦政府有法律授权确保和促进提格雷在其联邦机构（包括两院）中的代表权。 然而，该协议除了很大程度上成功地平息了该地区的激烈战斗之外，一再未能达到预期。最重要的是，它并没有帮助提格雷恢复民主。 提格雷人民解放阵线 (TPLF) 发言人米歇尔·阿斯吉多姆 (Michaele Asgedom) 表示：“提格雷超过 40% 的主权领土处于敌人控制之下。”他强调，该地区在多年冲突后无法“举行选举”。 阿斯吉多姆解释说，除了无数原本在邻国苏丹寻求庇护的人外，数百万因血腥内战而逃离提格雷的国内流离失所者还没有返回家园；他告诉德国之声，因此在提格雷举行的任何选举都不能代表所有提格雷人。 但当该国其他地区准备投票时，观察者们担心该地区脆弱的和平的不仅仅是不同的选民：2020 年至 2022 年的提格雷战争仍然投下长长的阴影。 2020 年，由于 COVID-19 大流行，阿比·艾哈迈德总理领导的埃塞俄比亚政府不得不推迟该国计划的选举。 提格雷人民解放阵线是该国北部提格雷地区最大、最具统治力的政党，指责阿比以这种方式延长其政府任期违宪，并继续安排自己的地方选举，并赢得了选举。 随后，...

The biblical vision reminds us that true peace comes when barriers of hostility are broken down, making disparate groups one. This calls for efforts to bridge divides and foster genuine...
reflection.zh: 提格雷地区被排除在埃塞俄比亚大选之外，凸显了一个国家内部可能持续存在的深刻分歧，导致紧张局势而非团结。圣经的愿景提醒我们，真正的和平在于拆毁敌意的隔墙，使不同的群体合而为一。这呼吁我们努力弥合分歧，促进所有人的真正包容。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
title.zh: 在网上向世界各地的人们出售有毒化学品的“毒贩”承认帮助自杀

summary.en: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A man has pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding suicides in Canada after he sold toxic chemicals online.

Kenneth Law, 60, entered the guilty pleas relating to Canadian victims in an Ontario court on Friday, as part of a deal with prosecutors who withdrew more serious murder charges.

Authorities said the former chef also sold about 1,200 packages of the toxic substances to recipients - who he met in online suicide forums - in 40 countries, including the UK.

Families of British victims have said they are angry with UK prosecutors for not charging Law, who is linked to the deaths of 79 Britons. The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) said the Canadian legal system will take the losses of UK families into account.

A letter from the CPS, seen by the BBC, said Law would not face charges in the UK because of legal complexities.

Specialist CPS prosecutor Andrew Hudson said including UK victims in the Canadian sentencing process was the "quickest and most effective route" to securing justice.

Hudson said a successful extradition was "far from guaranteed and would have taken years to conclude", and there was a risk if he was extradited that any prosecution "could have been blocked under double jeopardy principles".

He added: "A condition of our agreement with the Canadian prosecutor was that Kenneth Law's sentence must reflect the fact that people died in England and Wales as a direct result of using products that he supplied to them.

Law was also linked to the death of five people in Scotland and one in Northern Ireland.

Ontario man Ashtyn Prosser-Blake, 19, was one of Law's victims who died by suicide in March 2023.

"He was just such a super happy, really gentle soul, always looking to stand up for the underdog, the kids that got picked on," his mother Kim Prosser told the BBC.

Prosser-Blake's mental health declined after Covid - when he graduated he went to college for a year in Toronto before dropping out and moved home where he "just continued to struggle" before dying by suicide, his mother said.

"The pain of losing my son Ashtyn doesn't ease because someone sits behind bars," she said. "There is no solace in my healing journey to see someone else suffer."

In the UK, David Parfett's 22 year-old son, Thomas, used the substance said to have been sold to him by Law.

"Tom was somebody who really saw the joy in life. He would find humour in the weirdest places. I often think about his laugh," Parfett said.

"Tom was a massive football fan and he was a good footballer as well. I miss the opportunity to enjoy the 2026 World Cup with him."

Tom paid the equivalent of £50 ($67; C$92) for the substance. His body was found in a hotel in Sunbury-on-Thames, Surrey, in 2021.

Parfett said: "I had wanted Law to face charges in the UK... he really needed to...
body.zh: 加拿大一名男子因在网上出售有毒化学品而承认了 14 项协助自杀罪名。 60 岁的肯尼思·劳 (Kenneth Law) 周五在安大略省一家法院对加拿大受害者进行了认罪，作为与检察官撤回更严重谋杀指控的协议的一部分。 当局表示，这位前厨师还向包括英国在内的 40 个国家的接收者（他在在线自杀论坛上认识的接收者）出售了约 1,200 包有毒物质。 英国受害者家属表示，他们对英国检察官没有对劳提起诉讼感到愤怒，劳与 79 名英国人的死亡有关。皇家检察署（CPS）表示，加拿大法律体系将考虑英国家庭的损失。 英国广播公司(BBC)看到的一封来自英国皇家检察署的信函称，由于法律复杂性，劳不会在英国面临指控。 CPS 专业检察官安德鲁·哈德森 (Andrew Hudson) 表示，让英国受害者参与加拿大的量刑程序是确保正义的“最快、最有效的途径”。 哈德森表示，成功引渡“远不能保证，而且需要数年时间才能完成”，而且如果他被引渡，任何起诉“都可能根据双重危险原则被阻止”。 他补充说：“我们与加拿大检察官达成协议的一个条件是，肯尼思·劳的判决必须反映英格兰和威尔士的人们因使用他向他们提供的产品而直接死亡的事实。 该法律还与苏格兰五人死亡和北爱尔兰一人死亡有关。 19 岁的安大略男子 Ashtyn Prosser-Blake 是 Law 的受害者之一，他于 2023 年 3 月自杀身亡。 他的母亲金·普罗瑟 (Kim Prosser) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，“他是一个非常快乐、非常温柔的灵魂，总是为弱势群体、那些被欺负的孩子挺身而出。” 普罗瑟-布莱克的母亲说，新冠疫情之后，他的心理健康状况有所下降——毕业后，他在多伦多读了一年大学，然后退学并搬回家，在那里“继续挣扎”，然后自杀身亡。 “失去儿子阿什丁的痛苦并没有因为有人坐牢而减轻，”她说。 “在我的治疗之旅中，看到别人受苦并不能给我带来安慰。” 在英国，大卫·帕菲特 (David Parfett) 22 岁的儿子托马斯 (Thomas) 使用了据称是劳出售给他的物质。 “汤姆是一个真正看到生活乐趣的人。他会在最奇怪的地方找到幽默。我经常想起他的笑声，”帕菲特说。 “汤姆是一名狂热的足球迷，他也是一名优秀的足球运动员。我错过了和他一起享受2026年世界杯的机会。” 汤姆为该物质支付了相当于 50 英镑（67 美元；92 加元）的费用。 2021 年，他的尸体在萨里郡泰晤士河畔森伯里的一家酒店被发现。 帕菲特说：“我本来希望劳在英国面临指控……他真的需要……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Ex-head monk of China's 'kung fu temple' jailed for embezzlement
title.zh: 中国“功夫寺”前住持和尚因贪污被判入狱

summary.en: Shi Yongxin is sentenced to 24 years in prison for embezzlement and bribery.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The former head of China's famous Shaolin Temple - known as the birthplace of kung fu - has been sentenced to 24 years in jail for crimes including embezzlement and bribery.

Shi Yongxin had misappropriated temple assets worth more than 282m yuan ($42m; £31m) from 2003 to 2025, a court in the central Henan province said.

It said Shi had also used his official position to illegally obtain millions from temple construction projects, as well as offering huge bribes to Chinese officials.

Shi - whose birth name is Liu Yingcheng - had earlier admitted his guilt, China's state Xinhua news agency reported. On Friday, he said he would not appeal against the verdict.

The 1,500-year-old Shaolin Temple - located on a mountain range - attracts thousands of disciples from China and elsewhere every year.

Shi took office there as abbot in 1999, soon earning the nickname "CEO monk" for transforming the institution into a global brand.

Under his leadership, the temple started opening schools outside China and formed a travelling troupe of monks who performed Shaolin kung fu shows - the temple's signature style of martial arts.

Shi was investigated for embezzlement and fathering several children in 2015, but was later cleared of the charges.

In an interview with BBC Chinese that year, he said: "If there were a problem, it would have surfaced long ago."

The name "Shaolin Temple" has gained prominence in pop culture over the years, including being the title of a 1982 film starring Jet Li.

The temple is referenced in songs by American hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan and inspired a spin-off of the video game Mortal Kombat.
body.zh: 中国著名功夫发源地少林寺的前掌门因贪污和受贿等罪被判处 24 年有期徒刑。 河南省中部一家法院表示，从 2003 年到 2025 年，释永信挪用了价值超过 2.82 亿元人民币（4200 万美元；3100 万英镑）的寺庙资产。 据称，施还利用其职务之便，从寺庙建设项目中非法获取数百万美元，并向中国官员行贿。 据中国官方新华社报道，石本名刘英成早些时候已承认有罪。周五，他表示不会对判决提出上诉。 拥有 1,500 年历史的少林寺坐落在山脉上，每年吸引着来自中国和其他地方的数千名弟子。 1999年，释永信出任方丈，很快就因将该机构转变为全球品牌而赢得了“CEO和尚”的绰号。 在他的领导下，少林寺开始在中国境外开设学校，并组建了一个由僧人组成的巡回演出团，表演少林功夫表演——少林寺的标志性武术风格。 2015年，石因贪污和生下几个孩子而受到调查，但后来被洗清了罪名。 当年接受BBC中文采访时，他说：“如果有问题，早就浮现出来了。” 多年来，“少林寺”这个名字在流行文化中占据了重要地位，其中包括成为 1982 年李连杰主演的电影的片名。 美国嘻哈乐队 Wu-Tang Clan 的歌曲中提到了这座寺庙，并为电子游戏《真人快打》的衍生作品提供了灵感。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Fuel hikes: Is ride-hailing becoming a luxury in Lagos?
title.zh: 燃油上涨：拉各斯的叫车服务是否已成为一种奢侈品？

summary.en: Rising fares and fuel costs are reshaping how ride‑hailing is used in Lagos. While some commuters rely on it more than ever, others are cutting back, switching apps or turning to cheaper transport.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Rising fares and fuel costs are reshaping how ride‑hailing is used in Lagos. While some commuters rely on it more than ever, others are cutting back, switching apps or turning to cheaper transport.

Every weekday morning, Blessing Ade leaves her house in Lagos, Nigeria, carrying her baby in a wrap. The first-time mother, who lives in a two-story building, only steps outside when her ride is already waiting at the gate.

"I book my ride before I step out of the house," she told DW. "The ride has to be in front of my gate, not that I'm outside and then standing under the sun." For her, public buses are not an option. "Right now, I'm not thinking bus. I don't even see it as an option. I've canceled it."

Rising fuel prices and fare surges are changing how ride‑hailing is used in Lagos. Some commuters say they rely on ride‑hailing more than ever, while others are cutting back, switching between apps or abandoning trips when prices rise.

Fuel prices in Nigeria began rising sharply after President Bola Ahmed Tinubu announced the removal of the long-standing petrol subsidy during his inauguration speech on May 29, 2023. The spike significantly affected transportation, food prices and the overall cost of living in Africa's most populous nation.

Pemi Aderogba, 29, who also lives in Lagos, a city that is home to an estimated 20 million people according to the UN , says ride‑hailing remains central to how she gets around.

"Very often I feel like if I have to go out seven days a week, I would probably use them for six days or even all seven days," Aderogba, who works as a development professional, told DW.

She combines different modes depending on the purpose. For work, she uses Shuttlers, an app for shared rides, and buses, but for most other trips, individual ride‑hailing dominates.

"Most times when I'm going out, aside from work, I always use Uber and inDrive," she explained, adding that she stopped using one platform because "they became very expensive."

"It's just always about the distance and comfort for me," she stressed. "I always want to be comfortable."

For 35-year-old media practitioner Saanu Olomoda, ride‑hailing once played a much larger role in her routine.

"If it were 2 or 3 years ago, I would say yes. Ride-hailing apps played a huge role in my daily life," Olomoda said. "But now they play a smaller role... I hardly use them these days."

She still checks prices before traveling, but often leaves the apps when fares rise.

"What I do when the price feels too high, I close the app and go get the yellow bus."

The iconic, bright-yellow commercial minibus with twin black stripes, popularly known as danfo, serves as the primary mode of informal public transportation in Lagos....
body.zh: 票价和燃料成本的上涨正在改变拉各斯的网约车使用方式。虽然一些通勤者比以往任何时候都更加依赖它，但其他人正在减少出行、更换应用程序或转向更便宜的交通。 每个工作日的早晨，布莱辛·阿德 (Blessing Ade) 都会抱着她的孩子离开尼日利亚拉各斯的家。这位第一次当妈妈的人住在一栋两层楼的建筑里，当她的车已经在门口等候时，她才走出去。 “我在出门前就预订了行程，”她告诉德国之声。 “骑行必须在我的门前，而不是我在外面然后站在阳光下。”对她来说，公共巴士不是一个选择。 “现在，我不考虑公共汽车。我什至不认为它是一个选择。我已经取消了它。” 燃油价格上涨和票价飙升正在改变拉各斯的网约车使用方式。一些通勤者表示，他们比以往任何时候都更加依赖叫车服务，而另一些人则在减少出行次数、切换应用程序或在价格上涨时放弃出行。 2023 年 5 月 29 日，总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布 (Bola Ahmed Tinubu) 在就职演说中宣布取消长期存在的汽油补贴后，尼日利亚的燃油价格开始大幅上涨。油价飙升严重影响了这个非洲人口最多国家的交通、食品价格和整体生活成本。 29 岁的佩米·阿德罗巴 (Pemi Aderogba) 也居住在拉各斯，根据联合国的数据，这座城市约有 2000 万人口，她表示，网约车仍然是她出行的核心方式。 “我经常觉得，如果我必须每周外出 7 天，我可能会使用它们六天甚至全部 7 天，”开发专业人士阿德罗巴告诉德国之声。 她根据目的结合不同的模式。在工作中，她使用 Shuttlers（一款共享乘车应用程序）和公共汽车，但对于大多数其他旅行，个人乘车服务占主导地位。 “大多数时候，当我外出时，除了工作之外，我总是使用 Uber 和 inDrive，”她解释道，并补充说，她停止使用其中一个平台是因为“它们变得非常昂贵”。 “对我来说，距离和舒适感始终是最重要的，”她强调说。 “我总是想要舒服。” 对于 35 岁的媒体从业者 Saanu Olomoda 来说，网约车曾经在她的日常生活中扮演着重要的角色。 “如果是两三年前，我会说是的。叫车应用程序在我的日常生活中发挥了巨大的作用，”奥洛莫达说。 “但现在它们的作用变小了……我这些天几乎不使用它们了。” 她在旅行前仍然会检查价格，但当票价上涨时，她经常会离开应用程序。 “当价格感觉太高时，我会关闭应用程序并乘坐黄色巴士。” 标志性的亮黄色商用小巴，带有双黑条纹，俗称丹佛，是拉各斯非正式公共交通的主要模式。

title.en: 'Controversial' North Korean invasion setting for next Call of Duty game
title.zh: 下一款《使命召唤》游戏将以“有争议的”朝鲜入侵为背景

summary.en: Developer Infinity Ward announced that the next installment of the Call of Duty game series will feature a controversial North Korean invasion setting. The company stated the game aims for the 'military authenticity' the franchise is known for.
summary.zh: 开发商Infinity Ward宣布，下一款《使命召唤》系列游戏将以“有争议的”朝鲜入侵为背景。该公司表示，该游戏将秉承该系列闻名的“军事真实性”。

body.en:
The next Call of Duty game has been revealed, with much of the reaction focused on its campaign set around a fictional renewed conflict on the Korean Peninsula.

Modern Warfare 4, due out 23 October, partly follows South Korean soldiers battling a full-scale North Korean invasion.

Dr Sarah Son, Senior Lecturer in Korean Studies at the University of Sheffield, said the move "could be controversial" as it "turns still-unresolved war into entertainment". Some Koreans reacted more positively, with one calling Korea's inclusion in one of gaming's biggest franchises a "symbolic moment" .

Developer Infinity Ward said the game will be "grounded in the military authenticity Modern Warfare is known for".

The game will launch on current-generation consoles, PC and Nintendo Switch 2, marking the first mainline Call of Duty to skip PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

The game's trailer , which has already been viewed almost 22 million times within a day of release, focuses on a group of young South Korean conscripts on what appears to be a routine patrol, before a missile attack from North Korea throws them into full-scale war.

Players will also get to play once again as fan-favourite Captain Price, who will appear in different missions in several cities alongside the Korean campaign.

The release of any Call of Duty game is a global cultural event and posts about the latest version have amassed more than three million interactions within 24 hours of the announcement across Instagram, TikTok, X and Facebook.

Among them, some Koreans reacting to the setting have embraced Infinity Ward's decision to tell the story from the perspective of ordinary South Korean soldiers caught up in the conflict.

"The soldiers' faces and the atmosphere of the locations all have that familiar Korean feel, so I'm genuinely excited," said one .

"When I heard the rumour that the ROK Army would be in it, my immediate reaction was 'obviously just an extra...'," posted another .

"Then I heard they're not just present but one of the playable protagonists? And not even special forces, handled from the perspective of an ordinary conscripted soldier, that's what gets me."

Beyond the setting, Infinity Ward announced significant changes to gameplay, including revamped movement mechanics and more interactive environments.

The studio is also overhauling DMZ, its extraction-style multiplayer mode, and introducing a new 'Frontlines' system designed to make battles feel more dynamic and reactive.

Modern Warfare has previously courted controversy through storylines inspired by real-world events and conflicts.

Missions such as "No Russian", where players had the option to shoot civilians in an airport in Moscow, and later depictions of war crimes and terrorism have prompted debate about how far...
body.zh: 下一款《使命召唤》游戏已经揭晓，大部分反应都集中在其围绕朝鲜半岛虚构的新冲突展开的战役上。 《现代战争 4》将于 10 月 23 日上映，部分讲述了韩国士兵与朝鲜全面入侵作战的故事。 谢菲尔德大学韩国研究高级讲师莎拉·森博士表示，此举“可能会引起争议”，因为它“将尚未解决的战争变成了娱乐”。一些韩国人的反应更为积极，其中一人称韩国加入游戏最大的特许经营权之一是一个“象征性时刻”。 开发商 Infinity Ward 表示，这款游戏将“以《现代战争》闻名的军事真实性为基础”。 该游戏将在当前一代游戏机、PC 和 Nintendo Switch 2 上发布，这标志着第一款跳过 PlayStation 4 和 Xbox One 的主线《使命召唤》。 该游戏的预告片在发布一天之内就已被观看了近 2200 万次，主要讲述了一群年轻的韩国应征入伍者在进行例行巡逻，然后朝鲜的导弹袭击将他们卷入全面战争的故事。 玩家还将再次扮演深受粉丝喜爱的普莱斯队长，他将在韩国战役中出现在多个城市的不同任务中。 任何一款《使命召唤》游戏的发布都是一项全球文化活动，有关最新版本的帖子在发布后 24 小时内在 Instagram、TikTok、X 和 Facebook 上积累了超过 300 万次互动。 其中，一些对这一背景做出反应的韩国人接受了 Infinity Ward 决定从陷入冲突的普通韩国士兵的角度来讲述这个故事的决定。 “士兵们的面孔和场景的气氛都有一种熟悉的韩国感觉，所以我真的很兴奋，”一位人士说道。 另一位网友写道：“当我听到韩国陆军将参与其中的传言时，我的第一反应是‘显然只是一个额外的……’”。 “然后我听说他们不仅在场，而且还是可玩的主角之一？甚至不是特种部队，从普通应征士兵的角度来处理，这就是让我着迷的地方。” 除了设定之外，Infinity Ward 还宣布了游戏玩法的重大变化，包括改进的运动机制和更具互动性的环境。 该工作室还对 DMZ 及其提取式多人游戏模式进行了彻底改革，并引入了新的“前线”系统，旨在使战斗感觉更加动态和反应。 《现代战争》此前曾因受现实世界事件和冲突启发的故事情节而引起争议。 诸如“禁止俄罗斯人”之类的任务，玩家可以选择在莫斯科机场射杀平民，后来对战争罪和恐怖主义的描述引发了关于……到底能走多远的争论。

reflection.en: As entertainment increasingly blurs lines with real-world geopolitical tensions, this news invites us to consider the content we consume and create. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to fix our thoughts on what is true, noble, and worthy of praise, prompting reflection on how simulated conflicts align with these values.
reflection.zh: 随着娱乐与现实世界地缘政治紧张局势的界限日益模糊，这则新闻邀请我们思考我们所消费和创造的内容。腓立比书4:8鼓励我们将思想集中在真实、高尚和值得称赞的事物上，促使我们反思模拟冲突如何与这些价值观相符。

title.en: South Korea pushes nuclear-powered submarine plan
title.zh: 韩国推动核动力潜艇计划

summary.en: South Korea is planning to develop nuclear-powered submarines, a move that comes amidst increasing undersea military capabilities among its regional rivals and raises concerns about a broader military buildup in the region.
summary.zh: 韩国正计划开发核动力潜艇，此举正值其地区竞争对手加强水下军事能力之际，引发了对该地区军事建设扩大的担忧。

body.en:
Seoul's plans for nuclear-powered vessels come as regional rivals ramp up undersea capabilities, raising concerns over a widening military buildup.

The South Korean government has announced plans to develop nuclear-powered attack submarines, with the first vessel to be operational by the mid-2030s, as part of an effort to strengthen its naval capabilities.

Analysts point out that when taken with developments already under way or being considered by China, North Korea and Japan, it is clear that northeast Asia is already very firmly embroiled in an undersea arms race.

Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back unveiled Seoul's plan at a Tuesday meeting of the Future Defense Strategy Committee at the naval base in Jinhae, emphasizing the importance of developing a system to counter North Korea's advances in submarine technology .

The plan — known as the Jangbogo-N Project, after the South's first submarine — emphasizes that nuclear-powered submarines "possess dramatically enhanced operational capabilities compared to existing diesel submarines."

The submarines will therefore "play a core role in responding to threats such as North Korea's submarine-launched nuclear and missile threats," according to the Defense Ministry.

The Ministry described the plan as a "national strategic project" that will utilize South Korea's shipbuilding and nuclear power technologies, with a decade-long construction period expected and and a 30-year operational life.

Seoul is pushing ahead with the plan after the United States endorsed South Korea's pursuit of conventionally armed, nuclear-powered submarines, with Washington also pledging to help its Asian ally build the vessels, including their propulsion systems.

During talks with South Korean President Lee Jae-myung in October, US President Donald Trump said the submarines would be built in Philadelphia. However, a more recent statement insists they will be constructed in South Korea.

Nevertheless, the announcement marks significant progress in a South Korean ambition that dates back to the early 1990s.

"A combination of military, corporate and political actors in South Korea has long wanted to pursue nuclear-powered submarines and Trump is the first American president to greenlight the effort with Seoul," said Leif-Eric Easley, a professor of international studies at Ewha Womans University in Seoul.

Yet "political will, diplomatic approval and defense budgets are not the only hurdles to clear," he told DW, pointing to the need to address technology transfer and nonproliferation concerns, as well as "significant and time-consuming" industrial challenges.

title.en: Former US attorney general Pam Bondi testifies in congressional Epstein probe
title.zh: 美国前司法部长帕姆·邦迪在国会爱泼斯坦调查中作证

summary.en: The testimony comes about a month after America's top prosecutor was ousted by US President Donald Trump.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Former US Attorney General Pam Bondi is appearing in front of a congressional panel probing convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

Bondi, who was removed from her post as America's top law enforcement officer by US President Donald Trump in April, will testify on the US Justice Department's handling of its release of the Epstein files.

The testimony in Washington DC is taking place behind closed doors, but transcripts or video might be released at a later time.

Bondi was formally summoned by the House Oversight Committee in March, just before Trump announced her ouster as his administration's top prosecutor.

In opening remarks to the committee, Bondi said she was "proud" of the department's release of documents related to the convicted sex offender, for which she has been widely criticised.

"We demonstrated an unprecedented commitment to transparency in the Department's search for, collection, and review of the Epstein files, producing nearly 3 million pages of material, including thousands of videos and hundreds of thousands of images," she said.

The committee's Republican chairman, James Comer, wrote in a subpoena letter that they are investigating the "possible mismanagement" of the Epstein investigation and compliance with the Epstein Files Transparency Act. That bill - which mandated US Department of Justice to publicly release unclassified records - was signed into law by Trump.

Ahead of today's meeting, Comer told reporters that successive governments had failed Epstein's victims and that Bondi will be pressed about her handling of the release of the documents.

"We're going to try to determine whether or not there could be more documents legally turned over," Comer said. "I want every document. I don't want anything held back and I think the majority of the committee's the same way."

The committee's leading Democrat Robert Garcia also said his side was "incredibly disappointed of the decision to not have this interview videotaped and then released to the American public."

Bondi's summons came weeks after Nancy Mace, a Republican lawmaker, accused the justice department of a "cover-up" in releasing the files and introduced a motion to subpoena Bondi - the former attorney general of Florida and who served on Trump's 2020 impeachment defence team.

The Trump administration and Bondi have faced enormous bipartisan pressure to release all documents related to the probe of the sex-trafficking financier and faced criticism over its handling of the files, including its failure to redact the names of Epstein's victims. Epstein died in prison while awaiting trial in 2019.

body.zh: 美国前司法部长帕姆·邦迪出现在国会小组面前，调查被定罪的性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦。 邦迪于四月被美国总统唐纳德·特朗普解除了美国最高执法官员的职务，她将就美国司法部处理爱泼斯坦档案的情况作证。 华盛顿特区的证词是闭门进行的，但文字记录或视频可能会在晚些时候发布。 今年三月，就在特朗普宣布解除邦迪政府最高检察官职务之前，邦迪被众议院监督委员会正式传唤。 邦迪在委员会的开幕词中表示，她对该部门公布与被定罪的性犯罪者有关的文件感到“自豪”，她因此受到了广泛的批评。 她说：“我们在司法部搜索、收集和审查爱泼斯坦档案方面表现出了前所未有的透明度承诺，制作了近 300 万页的材料，包括数千个视频和数十万张图像。” 该委员会的共和党主席詹姆斯·科默在传票中写道，他们正在调查爱泼斯坦调查中“可能存在的管理不善”以及爱泼斯坦文件透明度法案的遵守情况。该法案授权美国司法部公开发布非机密记录，并由特朗普签署成为法律。 在今天的会议之前，科默告诉记者，历届政府都辜负了爱泼斯坦的受害者，邦迪将因她处理这些文件的方式而受到压力。 “我们将尝试确定是否可以合法移交更多文件，”科默说。 “我想要每一份文件。我不希望任何事情被保留，我认为委员会的大多数成员也是如此。” 该委员会的主要民主党人罗伯特·加西亚也表示，他的一方“对不将这次采访录像并向美国公众发布的决定感到非常失望”。 几周前，共和党议员南希·梅斯 (Nancy Mace) 指责司法部在公布文件时“掩盖事实”，并提出传唤邦迪的动议。邦迪是佛罗里达州前总检察长，曾在特朗普 2020 年弹劾辩护团队中任职。 特朗普政府和邦迪面临着巨大的两党压力，要求公布与性交易金融家调查有关的所有文件，并因其处理文件的方式而受到批评，包括未能隐瞒爱泼斯坦受害者的姓名。 2019 年，爱泼斯坦在等待审判期间在监狱中去世。 2025 年 2 月，邦迪在接受福克斯新闻采访时宣称，她“现在就在我的办公桌上”有一份爱泼斯坦的知名客户名单，只是为了伸张正义……

title.en: Iran war: Oman stuck between Trump and Tehran
title.zh: 伊朗战争：阿曼夹在特朗普和德黑兰之间

summary.en: Oman, a key mediator between Washington and Tehran, faced a military strike threat from then-President Donald Trump, highlighting the precarious position of nations attempting to de-escalate international tensions.
summary.zh: 阿曼是华盛顿和德黑兰之间的重要调解国，却面临时任总统唐纳德·特朗普的军事打击威胁，这凸显了试图缓和国际紧张局势的国家所处的岌岌可危的境地。

body.en:
Oman is one of the most important mediators between Washington and Tehran. So why did Donald Trump threaten the sultanate with a military strike?

On Wednesday evening, US President Donald Trump said if Oman were to attempt to control the Strait of Hormuz in conjunction with Iran, the US would launch a military strike against the country at the southern tip of the Arabian Peninsula.

He was responding to a report by Iranian state television claiming that an unofficial draft agreement existed to restore shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz . The draft reportedly called for Iran and Oman to jointly regulate traffic in the waterway.

"Oman will behave like everyone else, or we'll have to blow them up," Trump told reporters when asked if he would accept such an agreement.

The unusually harsh threat is directed at a country that has long been regarded as a mediator in the Middle East.

"Oman has traditionally played a mediating role between the Arab Gulf states and Iran," Marcus Schneider, head of the Friedrich Ebert Foundation's Regional Project for Peace and Security in the Middle East in Beirut, told DW.

Stefan Lukas, founder of the analysis firm Middle East Minds, sees this as what makes the country unique. "Oman is one of the few remaining countries in the region that still maintains relatively stable relations with nearly all parties to the conflict," Lukas told DW.

With its location on the southern side of the Strait of Hormuz, Oman plays a key role in the current conflict .

At the same time, the sultanate maintains good relations with both Washington and Tehran and has repeatedly served as a venue for confidential talks.

The situation is delicate for Oman. The country is trying to maintain its role as a neutral mediator but is increasingly caught between the two sides.

"Since the start of the war, Oman has been among the Gulf states pushing hardest for de-escalation," said Schneider. Like the other states in the region, it fears being drawn into the conflict.

Oman relies on stable trade relations with China, India, Europe, and its neighbors. At the same time, Washington is increasing political pressure, while the proximity of war threatens the country's security.

However, there is little to suggest that Oman is actually seeking joint control of the Strait of Hormuz with Iran.

"Iran is increasingly portraying the strait as joint Iranian-Omani waters," said Schneider. In Oman itself, however, this idea is viewed with skepticism. Active participation in such measures would run counter to the interests of the other Gulf states.

Lukas also considers such reports to be "rather unrealistic." The government in Muscat has "absolutely no interest in joint control with Iran." What is crucial, rather, is restoring safe and uninterrupted...
body.zh: 阿曼是华盛顿和德黑兰之间最重要的调解者之一。那么，唐纳德·特朗普为何要以军事打击来威胁苏丹国呢？ 周三晚间，美国总统特朗普表示，如果阿曼试图与伊朗联合控制霍尔木兹海峡，美国将对阿拉伯半岛南端的该国发动军事打击。 他是在回应伊朗国家电视台的一篇报道，该报道称存在一份旨在恢复霍尔木兹海峡航运交通的非正式协议草案。据报道，该草案要求伊朗和阿曼共同监管该水道的交通。 当被问及是否会接受这样的协议时，特朗普告诉记者：“阿曼将像其他国家一样行事，否则我们将不得不炸毁他们。” 这一异常严厉的威胁是针对一个长期以来被视为中东调解者的国家。 贝鲁特弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会中东和平与安全区域项目负责人马库斯·施奈德告诉德国之声：“阿曼历来在阿拉伯海湾国家和伊朗之间发挥着调解作用。” 分析公司 Middle East Minds 的创始人斯特凡·卢卡斯 (Stefan Lukas) 认为，这就是这个国家的独特之处。卢卡斯告诉德国之声：“阿曼是该地区少数仍与冲突各方保持相对稳定关系的国家之一。” 阿曼位于霍尔木兹海峡南侧，在当前冲突中发挥着关键作用。 与此同时，苏丹国与华盛顿和德黑兰都保持着良好关系，并多次充当秘密会谈的场所。 阿曼的局势十分微妙。该国试图维持中立调解者的角色，但越来越夹在双方之间。 施奈德说：“自战争爆发以来，阿曼一直是最努力推动缓和局势的海湾国家之一。”与该地区其他国家一样，它担心被卷入冲突。 阿曼依赖与中国、印度、欧洲及其邻国的稳定贸易关系。与此同时，华盛顿正在加大政治压力，战争的临近威胁着国家的安全。 然而，几乎没有迹象表明阿曼实际上正在寻求与伊朗共同控制霍尔木兹海峡。 施奈德说：“伊朗越来越多地将海峡描述为伊朗和阿曼的共同水域。”然而，在阿曼国内，人们对这一想法持怀疑态度。积极参与此类措施将违背其他海湾国家的利益。 卢卡斯还认为此类报告“相当不现实”。马斯喀特政府“绝对没有兴趣与伊朗联合控制”。更重要的是，安全、不间断地恢复……

reflection.en: In a world often marked by escalating tensions, nations like Oman strive to be bridges of peace, even when facing immense pressure. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the constant call to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, a principle that guides such diplomatic efforts amidst global complexities. This pursuit of harmony requires wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满紧张局势的世界里，像阿曼这样的国家努力成为和平的桥梁，即使面临巨大压力。罗马书12:18提醒我们，要尽力与所有人和睦相处，这是在复杂的全球局势中指导此类外交努力的原则。这种对和谐的追求需要智慧和韧性，尤其是在被强大势力夹在中间时。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 'Very rough day': Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin rocket explodes on launch pad
title.zh: “非常艰难的一天”：杰夫·贝佐斯的蓝色起源火箭在发射台上爆炸

summary.en: Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket experienced an "anomaly" and exploded during a test on the launch pad, described by the company as a "very rough day."
summary.zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯旗下蓝色起源公司的新格伦火箭在发射台测试期间发生“异常”并爆炸，该公司称之为“非常艰难的一天”。

body.en:
Jeff Bezos says his space company Blue Origin has had a "very rough day" after its New ‌Glenn rocket exploded on the launch pad.

A Blue Origin New ‌Glenn rocket dramatically exploded on the launch pad during a test on Friday, in a setback for Bezos' space venture as it seeks to narrow the gap with its competitor, Elon Musk's SpaceX.

Video posted ‌by NASASpaceflight, a YouTube channel that livestreams launches from Florida, showed the New Glenn igniting on the pad before erupting into a massive fireball that billowed skyward, sending a towering plume of flames and smoke into the air.

Blue Origin ‌said it ‌had experienced ⁠an "anomaly", a term commonly used by rocket companies to describe a launch failure or explosion.

"We experienced an anomaly during today's hotfire test. All personnel have been accounted for. We will provide updates as we learn more," the company said on X.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A hotfire test is where a rocket engine is fired up while anchored to the ⁠ground.

In a separate X post, Bezos said ‌it was "too early to know the root cause" of the incident.

"Very rough day, but we'll rebuild whatever needs rebuilding and ‌get back to flying. It's worth it," he said.

Earlier this week, Blue Origin said it was preparing the New Glenn rocket to launch 48 Amazon Leo satellites into low Earth orbit, as part of efforts to build a broadband constellation to rival Musk's Starlink network. It did not provide a launch date.

Blue Origin has spent billions of dollars and about a decade developing New Glenn, a 29-storey-high rocket with a reusable first stage meant to compete with SpaceX's Falcon fleet and its more powerful Starship.

Musk responded on X to a video of the New Glenn explosion, saying: "Most unfortunate. Rockets are hard."

The US Federal Aviation Administration did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

body.zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯表示，他的太空公司蓝色起源在其新格伦火箭在发射台上爆炸后经历了“非常艰难的一天”。 蓝色起源的新格伦火箭在周五的一次测试中在发射台上发生了戏剧性爆炸，这对贝佐斯的太空冒险事业来说是一次挫折，因为该公司试图缩小与竞争对手埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 的差距。 NASASpaceflight（一个直播从佛罗里达州发射升空的 YouTube 频道）发布的视频显示，新格伦号在发射台上点火，然后喷发成一个巨大的火球，冲上天空，向空中喷射出高耸的火焰和烟雾。 蓝色起源表示，它经历了“异常”，这是火箭公司常用来描述发射失败或爆炸的术语。 该公司在 X 上表示：“我们在今天的热火测试中遇到了异常情况。所有人员均已被查明。我们将在了解更多信息后提供最新信息。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 热火测试是指将火箭发动机固定在地面上时启动。 贝佐斯在另一篇 X 帖子中表示，“现在了解该事件的根本原因还为时过早”。 “非常艰难的一天，但我们将重建所有需要重建的东西，并重新开始飞行。这是值得的，”他说。 本周早些时候，蓝色起源表示，它正在准备用新格伦火箭将 48 颗亚马逊狮子座卫星发射到近地轨道，作为建设宽带星座以与马斯克的星链网络竞争的努力的一部分。它没有提供发布日期。 蓝色起源花费了数十亿美元和大约十年的时间开发新格伦号，这是一款 29 层高的火箭，具有可重复使用的第一级，旨在与 SpaceX 的猎鹰舰队及其更强大的星际飞船竞争。 马斯克在 X 上对新格伦爆炸的视频做出了回应，他说：“最不幸的是。火箭很难。” 美国联邦航空管理局没有立即回应路透社的置评请求。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Even in ambitious endeavors like space exploration, setbacks and failures are an inevitable part of the journey. This "rough day" reminds us that challenges can forge perseverance and character, ultimately leading to hope. Such moments test our resolve but also offer opportunities for growth and renewed determination.
reflection.zh: 即使在太空探索这样雄心勃勃的努力中，挫折和失败也是旅程中不可避免的一部分。这个“艰难的一天”提醒我们，挑战可以磨砺毅力和品格，最终带来希望。这样的时刻考验我们的决心，但也提供了成长和重振决心的机会。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Benjamin Netanyahu says Israel will expand control of Gaza to 70 per cent
title.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡称以色列将把对加沙的控制扩大至70%

summary.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced plans to expand Israel's control of Gaza to 70 percent, stating this move is intended to "press" Hamas from "all sides".
summary.zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡宣布，以色列计划将对加沙的控制范围扩大至70%，称此举旨在从“四面八方”向哈马斯施压。

body.en:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he has directed the country's military to take more of the Gaza Strip, initially by seizing 70 per cent of the Palestinian territory, where the population is already ‌penned into a tiny enclave of land along the coast.

Israel effectively controls an estimated 64 per cent of the tiny coastal strip, bombarded to ruins by Israel's two-year military assault that followed the ‌2023 Hamas attack on southern Israel.

Under a truce brokered by the US in October that has failed to halt Israeli attacks or secure Hamas' disarmament, Israeli troops were meant to withdraw to a "Yellow Line" demarcating the extent of their control.

Marked on military maps, that line put Israel in control of 53 per cent of the Gaza Strip, with Hamas ruling the rest.

Reuters has reported that Israel has unilaterally moved the concrete blocks marking the Yellow Line on the ground deeper into Hamas-controlled territory.

Maps issued by the military in March showed an even bigger restricted area ‌that analysts say cordons off ‌about 64 per cent of the Gaza Strip's ⁠territory in total.

Netanyahu has repeatedly said in public remarks that the military controls more than 60 per cent of the enclave.

Speaking to a conference in a settlement in the occupied West Bank, the Israeli leader said even more of the Gaza Strip would be taken.

"We were at 50 [per cent], we moved to 60. My directive is to move to — let's go step by step," Netanyahu said on Thursday.

"First of all, 70. Let's start with that. We're pressing them (Hamas) from all sides. We'll deal with the remnants."

Netanyahu describes the territory Israel has seized in the Gaza Strip, Syria and Lebanon as "buffer zones" that can stave off potential militant attacks following the ⁠October 7 Hamas-led assault that set off the Gaza war.

Palestinians view Israel's widening ‌'buffer zone' in Gaza as a part of a strategy to permanently displace its residents, pointing to remarks from senior ministers, including defence chief Israel Katz, saying they want to encourage "voluntary migration" from the strip.

Israeli strikes have killed more than 900 people since the truce, health officials say, while Israel says four soldiers were killed by militants during the same period.

Israel and Hamas remain deadlocked in talks to advance a US plan for the Gaza Strip under which Israeli troops would withdraw and Hamas disarm.

body.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡表示，他已指示该国军队占领更多加沙地带，首先占领了 70% 的巴勒斯坦领土，那里的人口已经被圈养在沿海的一小片飞地里。 以色列实际上控制着这个狭小沿海地带约 64% 的面积，在 2023 年哈马斯袭击以色列南部后，以色列发动了为期两年的军事袭击，将其炸成废墟。 根据美国十月份斡旋的停战协议，以色列军队本应撤退到划定其控制范围的“黄线”，但该协议未能阻止以色列的袭击或确保哈马斯解除武装。 军事地图上标出的这条线使以色列控制了加沙地带 53% 的地区，哈马斯统治着其余地区。 路透社报道称，以色列单方面将地面上标记黄线的混凝土块移至哈马斯控制的领土深处。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 军方 3 月份发布的地图显示了一个更大的禁区，分析人士称该禁区封锁了加沙地带约 64% 的领土。 内塔尼亚胡多次在公开讲话中表示，军方控制着该飞地60%以上的土地。 这位以色列领导人在被占领的约旦河西岸定居点举行的一次会议上发表讲话时表示，将占领更多的加沙地带。 内塔尼亚胡周四表示：“我们的比例是 50%，现在已升至 60%。我的指示是，让我们一步一步来。” “首先，70。让我们从这个开始。我们从四面八方向他们（哈马斯）施压。我们将处理残余分子。” 内塔尼亚胡将以色列在加沙地带、叙利亚和黎巴嫩占领的领土描述为“缓冲区”，可以在10月7日哈马斯领导的袭击引发加沙战争后避免潜在的武装分子袭击。 巴勒斯坦人将以色列在加沙扩大“缓冲区”视为永久迁移其居民战略的一部分，并指出包括国防部长以色列·卡茨在内的高级部长的言论，称他们希望鼓励从加沙地带“自愿移民”。 卫生官员称，自停战以来，以色列的袭击已造成 900 多人死亡，以色列称同期有 4 名士兵被武装分子杀害。 以色列和哈马斯在推进美国加沙地带计划的谈判中仍陷入僵局，根据该计划，以色列军队将撤军，哈马斯将解除武装。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.zh: 圣经呼吁将寄居者视同本地人，爱他们如同爱自己，这为治理任何人口，尤其是在有争议的领土上，提供了一个深刻的原则。这一视角挑战领导者思考在其权柄下所有人的尊严和福祉，确保控制的扩大不会导致虐待或权利受损。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: 'Like diving in coffee': The toughest challenges facing the Laos cave rescue
title.zh: “就像在咖啡里潜水”：老挝洞穴救援面临的最严峻挑战

summary.en: An Australian diver is joining the mission — and says he's afraid of what's ahead.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Five men trapped inside a flooded cave in Laos have been found alive after more than a week underground.

But rescuers have said getting them out safely could prove to be the most difficult stage of the operation , with narrow passageways, muddy floodwaters and zero visibility complicating efforts.

The men were located deep inside a cave in Laos's central Xaysomboun province after specialist divers spent days navigating flooded tunnels and clearing debris left by a landslide triggered by heavy rain.

Rescue teams are continuing to search for two others who remain unaccounted for inside the cave.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Australian cave diver Josh Richards is among those heading to Laos to assist with the rescue effort.

Speaking to 7News, Richards said he's "scared", describing the conditions facing teams on the ground as akin to "diving in coffee". He said the five men who have been found are exhausted and hungry but remain in relatively good spirits.

"Being included in this is really about having a strong connection with Mikko Paasi, the lead cave rescuer who's out in Laos right now, and being kind of a small, wiggly guy who squeezes into small spaces," he said.

While the discovery of the men has reportedly provided a boost to rescuers, Richards warned extracting them would not be straightforward, citing extremely poor visibility and the narrow tunnels rescuers will need to navigate.

The challenge facing rescuers is reportedly going to be bringing the trapped men back through a hazardous cave system they may have little ability to navigate themselves.

According to the ABC, rescue teams spent days battling floodwaters, landslide debris and tight cave restrictions before locating the group alive. Some passages are said to be as narrow as 60cm wide.

The five men were found in what rescuers have described as a terminal chamber, about 300m from the cave entrance.

In social media posts, Paasi — a Finnish diver who played a major role in the rescue of a youth soccer team from a Thai cave in 2018 — described the environment as "extremely remote and hostile", involving flooded passages, collapse hazards and concerns about air quality.

According to reports, just reaching the cave entrance has proved challenging, with rescuers required to complete a steep 4km trek through mountainous jungle terrain before entering the cave system.

summary.en: A US official has reported a tentative deal between Iran and the United States to extend a ceasefire, which would allow maritime traffic to flow through the Strait of Hormuz. The agreement is still awaiting final approval.

body.en:
United States and Iranian negotiators have reached a tentative agreement to extend the ceasefire in the three-month-old war by 60 days and start a new round of talks on Iran's nuclear program, US officials familiar with the matter told several news outlets.

Iran did not immediately confirm any deal, and the official noted that US President Donald Trump has yet to sign off on it.

The emerging memorandum of understanding came as the fragile ceasefire in the war between the US and Iran appeared to be wavering .

The latest flare-up in fighting happened less than a day earlier, when the US and Iran traded strikes.

The memorandum makes clear that Iran will not be able to impose tolls on the Strait of Hormuz and that Iran will have to remove all mines from the vital waterway within 30 days, according to the official, who was not authorised to comment publicly and spoke on condition of anonymity.

According to four sources familiar with the matter, the agreement would extend the truce by another 60 days and allow traffic to flow through the strategic waterway while negotiators tackle difficult issues such as Iran's nuclear program.

During the war, Iran has effectively closed the strait, which had been the conduit for about a fifth of the world's oil and natural gas trade.

US treasury secretary Scott Bessent predicted at a news briefing that the cost of oil could "come down very quickly" once a deal is finalised.

Iran has said it's letting some commercial vessels pass — about two dozen daily in recent days, compared with more than 100 a day before the war — but the Islamic Republic also has charged tolls for at least some ships.

It set up a formal gatekeeper agency earlier this month, spurring a new round of US sanctions this week.

Under the tentative agreement, the US would gradually lift its naval blockade on Iranian ports. The US would also agree to relax sanctions, allowing Iran to sell more of its oil.

A second US official, who also spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss the private diplomacy, said the broad outlines of an agreement have been reached but stressed that until Trump signs off on it, there is no deal.

The official said there are still questions about whether Trump will accept the proposal.

Iranian sources cited by local media also said a deal would only be complete when announced by Iran, not unilaterally by Trump.

title.en: Ex-head monk of China's 'kung fu temple' jailed for embezzlement
title.zh: 中国“功夫寺”前住持和尚因贪污被判入狱

summary.en: Shi Yongxin is sentenced to 24 years in prison for embezzlement and bribery.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The former head of China's famous Shaolin Temple - known as the birthplace of kung fu - has been sentenced to 24 years in jail for crimes including embezzlement and bribery.

Shi Yongxin had misappropriated temple assets worth more than 282m yuan ($42m; £31m) from 2003 to 2025, a court in the central Henan province said.

It said Shi had also used his official position to illegally obtain millions from temple construction projects, as well as offering huge bribes to Chinese officials.

Shi - whose birth name is Liu Yingcheng - had earlier admitted his guilt, China's state Xinhua news agency reported. On Friday, he said he would not appeal against the verdict.

The 1,500-year-old Shaolin Temple - located on a mountain range - attracts thousands of disciples from China and elsewhere every year.

Shi took office there as abbot in 1999, soon earning the nickname "CEO monk" for transforming the institution into a global brand.

Under his leadership, the temple started opening schools outside China and formed a travelling troupe of monks who performed Shaolin kung fu shows - the temple's signature style of martial arts.

Shi was investigated for embezzlement and fathering several children in 2015, but was later cleared of the charges.

In an interview with BBC Chinese that year, he said: "If there were a problem, it would have surfaced long ago."

The name "Shaolin Temple" has gained prominence in pop culture over the years, including being the title of a 1982 film starring Jet Li.

The temple is referenced in songs by American hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan and inspired a spin-off of the video game Mortal Kombat.

summary.en: A German delegation, known as the Berlin-Taipei Parliamentary Friendship Group, recently visited Taiwan, drawing criticism from Beijing. Two lawmakers told DW the visit was important for expanding economic partnerships.

body.en:
A German delegation, known as the Berlin-Taipei Parliamentary Friendship Group, recently visited Taiwan, drawing criticism from Beijing. Two lawmakers told DW the visit was important for expanding economic partnerships.

While German Economic Affairs Minister Katherina Reiche is visiting Beijing , a delegation from the Bundestag, Germany's lower house of parliament is in  Taiwan . 

The Berlin-Taipei Parliamentary Friendship Group, a cross-party association of MPs that promotes international exchange, has traveled there to "strengthen economic and cultural cooperation with one of the region's most important democratic partners," the Bundestag said in a statement.

Till Steffen of the Green Party is leading the five-member delegation, which also includes lawmakers Klaus-Peter Willsch and Markus Reichel from Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservative Christian Democrats (CDU) , as well as Rainer Kraft from the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) and Mandy Eissing from the Left Party .

The nine-day trip has sparked criticism from Beijing. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said China has always opposed any form of official exchanges between its diplomatic partners and Taiwan.

Beijing sees self-ruled Taiwan as a breakaway province that one day will be "reunited" with the mainland.

"It is in Germany's interest to have a balanced situation and not to depend solely on China," said delegation leader Steffen. Economic dependence on China — for example in batteries for electric cars — has put Germany in a difficult position, he added.

"It is fine to do business with Beijing, but we should not become dependent on China," Steffen said. "That is why it is necessary to maintain close relations with other countries at the same time. It is therefore a good thing that we are carrying out a joint research project with Taiwan on the batteries of the future." 

The AfD's Kraft points out that before German reunification in 1990, China maintained diplomatic relations with both the Federal Republic of Germany (FRG) and the German Democratic Republic (GDR) at the same time.

Although Germany does not maintain official diplomatic relations with Taiwan, it has economic, cultural and research ties with the island.

"It is very important for Germany to be a partner to Taiwan," he told DW. "Taiwan is a global leader in the semiconductor sector. Semiconductors are essential for the economy of the future — for artificial intelligence and data centers. Given our economic challenges, Germany must not miss the opportunity to remain economically strong in the future."

Taiwanese semiconductor giant TSMC has been building a new factory in the eastern German state of Saxony since 2024.

verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: How did this novel about food win a Booker Prize this year?
title.zh: 这本关于美食的小说今年是如何赢得布克奖的？

summary.en: Taiwan Travelogue, a novel translated from Mandarin Chinese, has made history by becoming the first of its kind to win the prestigious Booker Prize. The book focuses on themes related to food and culture.
summary.zh: 小说《台湾游记》成为首部获得久负盛名的布克奖的华语译作，创造了历史。该书以美食和文化为主题。

body.en:
Taiwan Travelogue, a tale of forbidden love and Taiwanese food, has won the International Booker Prize.

It's the first novel translated from Mandarin Chinese to win the prestigious award. BBC Chinese met with author Yang Shuang-zi for a food tour, and to learn more about her inspiration behind the book.

Rescuers in Laos have found five villagers alive inside a flooded cave after they were trapped for a week.

The BBC's Sumedha Pal described how difficult it was to be standing in the streets of Delhi as temperatures rose to 45C .

The temple has moved the flame to a different location and authorities said the fire may have been caused by it, according to Japan Times.

A North Korean women's football team played in South Korea marking the first time athletes from the North have crossed the border in nearly 8 years.

Rounds of gunfire were heard but officials have not revealed who fired the shots.

Pakistan says it hit 'military and terrorist infrastructure' - but the UN and victims' families reject this claim.

Officials said the group had been hiking up the active volcano despite a climbing ban.

Japan's PM is pushing to revise country's pacifist constitution - and it's causing controversy.

Analysts say the daughter of North Korea’s leader Kim Jong Un is not just growing up - she’s being styled for succession.

A glamping facility was destroyed by the raging torrent in Bogor, West Java on 4 May.

At least 15 people have died after a train crashed into the female-only carriage of a commuter train in Bekasi.

Thousands of people have been displaced after a fire destroyed around 1,000 homes in Malaysia's Sabah state.

The escape of Neukgu, a two-year-old wolf, from a zoo in the city of Daejon captured national attention.

The Philippine President challenged anyone questioning his fitness to join him in the gym.

Asha Bhosle died in Mumbai on Sunday after being admitted to the hospital following a heart attack.

K-pop stars BTS kicked off their marathon world tour in South Korea, with a heavy nod to their new album Arirang.

The megastars kick off their grandest tour, the largest in K-pop history, in Seoul on Thursday after a nearly four-year hiatus.

Min Aung Hlaing presided over his last military parade in Myanmar before he takes up the role of president.

Drivers are queuing for hours at petrol stations in Myanmar as the Iran war continues to send shockwaves across the globe.

BBC News Asia Business Correspondent Suranajana Tewari spoke to people taking to the streets of Manila.
body.zh: 《台湾游记》讲述了禁忌之爱和台湾美食的故事，荣获国际布克奖。 这是第一部获得这一殊荣的中文翻译小说。 BBC中文网采访了作家杨双子，进行美食之旅，并进一步了解她这本书背后的灵感。 老挝的救援人员在一个被洪水淹没的山洞里发现了五名被困一周的村民，他们还活着。 BBC 的 Sumedha Pal 描述了当气温升至 45 摄氏度时站在德里的街道上是多么困难。 据《日本时报》报道，寺庙已将火苗移至其他地点，当局表示火灾可能是由此引起的。 朝鲜女子足球队在韩国比赛，这是近八年来朝鲜运动员首次跨越边境。 听到几声枪响，但官员们没有透露是谁开枪的。 巴基斯坦称其袭击了“军事和恐怖主义基础设施”，但联合国和受害者家属否认了这一说法。 官员们表示，尽管有攀登禁令，该组织仍在攀登活火山。 日本首相正在推动修改该国的和平宪法，这引起了争议。 分析人士表示，朝鲜领导人金正恩的女儿不仅在成长，而且正在为接班人做好准备。 5 月 4 日，西爪哇省茂物市的一处豪华露营设施被汹涌的洪流摧毁。 一辆火车撞上勿加泗通勤列车的女性专用车厢，造成至少 15 人死亡。 马来西亚沙巴州发生火灾，烧毁了约 1,000 所房屋，导致数千人流离失所。 两岁大的狼 Neukgu 从大田市动物园逃跑引起了全国关注。 菲律宾总统要求任何质疑他健康状况的人都和他一起去健身房。 阿莎·博斯勒 (Asha Bhosle) 因心脏病突发入院，于周日在孟买去世。 韩国流行歌星防弹少年团 (BTS) 在韩国拉开了马拉松世界巡演的序幕，向他们的新专辑《阿里郎》致敬。 经过近四年的中断后，这些巨星将于周四在首尔开始他们最盛大的巡演，这也是韩国流行音乐历史上规模最大的巡演。 敏昂莱主持了就任总统之前在缅甸的最后一次阅兵。 随着伊朗战争继续在全球范围内产生冲击波，司机们在缅甸的加油站排队几个小时。 BBC 新闻亚洲商业记者 Suranajana Tewari 向走上马尼拉街头的人们发表讲话。

reflection.en: This literary achievement reminds us of the profound capacity for human creativity, a reflection of our being God's handiwork. Through stories, even those centered on food, we connect across cultures and celebrate the good works we are created to do, enriching the world with beauty and understanding.
reflection.zh: 这一文学成就提醒我们人类拥有深刻的创造力，这正是我们作为雅伟杰作的体现。通过故事，即使是那些以美食为中心的故事，我们也能跨越文化界限，庆祝我们被造所要行的善工，以美和理解丰富世界。

verse.textEn: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
verse.textZh: 我们原是他的工作，在基督耶稣里造成的，为要叫我们行善，就是神所预备叫我们行的。

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has disclosed details of China's advanced high-tech policing system to DW. This system uses facial recognition at ski resorts and tracks individuals on trains, compiling comprehensive "holistic profiles" that leave foreigners with no place to hide.
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车上的追踪，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cellphone numbers, visa details and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watch list.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners; it accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai, for example.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

This massive data-fusion effort...
body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是一个综合数据库，包含 2021 年左右驻京的几乎所有外国记者，包括在出入境局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在这份中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖于街角的警察摄像头；例如，它可以准确记录目标从北京或上海抵达时所乘坐的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统会记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这种大规模的数据融合工作......

reflection.en: The news of pervasive high-tech surveillance highlights the vulnerability of individuals when state power becomes absolute. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that unchecked authority can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless populace. It calls us to reflect on the importance of freedom and the dignity of every person, even in the face of overwhelming systems.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的高科技监控新闻凸显了当国家权力变得绝对时，个人所面临的脆弱性。箴言28:15提醒我们，不受约束的权力对无助的民众来说，可能像危险的捕食者。它呼吁我们反思自由的重要性以及每个人的尊严，即使面对压倒性的系统。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
title.zh: 四方安全对话能否保持相关性以促进印太安全？

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.
summary.zh: 美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚四国外长——统称为“四方安全对话”——需要搁置过去的分歧，才能使该联盟继续成为对抗中国的有效手段。

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the United States , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days startng Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

title.en: Numbers of Tibetan exiles plummet as China tightens grip
title.zh: 中国收紧控制，藏人流亡人数锐减

summary.en: The number of Tibetans seeking exile has significantly decreased due to increased difficulty and danger in escaping Beijing-controlled Tibet. This decline raises concerns about the long-term preservation of Tibetan culture.
summary.zh: 由于逃离北京控制下的西藏变得更加复杂和危险，寻求流亡的藏人数量大幅下降。这一趋势引发了人们对西藏文化未来保护的担忧。

body.en:
Fewer Tibetans are seeking exile, as escaping Beijing-controlled Tibet has become more complicated and dangerous. The drop raises questions about preserving the future of Tibetan culture.

For decades, the steady flow of Tibetans escaping across the Himalayas into India and Nepal served as a barometer of conditions inside Tibet.

From the late 1990s through the mid‑2000s, several thousand Tibetans sought exile every year, bringing firsthand accounts of political restrictions, cultural pressures and daily life under Chinese rule. 

But data from the Central Tibetan Administration in Dharamsala, the de facto capital of Tibetans in exile where the 14th Dalai Lama also resides, has revealed a collapse in the number of newly arrived Tibetans

Between 1995 and 1999, more than 12,000 Tibetans successfully sought exile. In the past five years, that number has plummeted to just 81.

With fewer Tibetans able to leave, independent information is becoming scarcer. That has made Beijing's policies, like religious regulation, language reforms, or rural relocation, more opaque to the outside world.

This comes as Beijing is increasingly promoting its own narratives on development and stability in Tibet. 

Lobsang, a middle-aged man who left Tibet in 2010, said the drop in the number of exiles comes as China has tightened its grip.

"Since 2008, the security architecture within Tibet has undergone a total transformation," he told DW.

"What we see now is a high-tech surveillance web where every village, every monastery and every household is monitored. Reaching the border is now nearly impossible for the average Tibetan," he added. 

The data suggests that the steepest drop in exiles began after large-scale protests in 2008 that spread across Tibet ahead of the Beijing Summer Olympics, prompting a heavy security response from Chinese authorities.

In the years that followed, Beijing expanded policing, digital surveillance and border enforcement across the Tibetan Plateau. 

Chinese authorities say their policies in Tibet have improved living standards, built out infrastructure and reduced poverty, leading to fewer people leaving.

The Chinese government has invested heavily in infrastructure , urban development and public services across Tibetan regions. In the eyes of Beijing, the porous border was a liability.

"The young Tibetan population … is increasingly migrating to larger [Chinese] cities and seeking to benefit from the growing Chinese economy," said Atul Kumar, a fellow with the strategic studies program at the Delhi-based Observer Research Foundation (ORF) think tank.

body.en:
But when petrol prices began climbing earlier this year , the Sydney office worker started looking for ways to reduce her weekly spending.

Now, she walks part of the journey and catches a bus for the remainder of her commute.

"With the cost of groceries, housing and pretty much everything else going up, fuel was one of the areas where I felt I could save a little bit of coin without too much effort."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

And she isn't alone, according to a new survey from Monash University which found almost half of Australians respondents changed the way they travel in response to rising fuel prices, with younger people and lower-income households driving much of the shift.

The national study surveyed 2,177 Australian adults in April — after petrol prices began climbing in March — and found 45 per cent had already changed their travel behaviour, while a further 37 per cent were considering switching to a different mode of transport.

While the research has not yet been peer-reviewed, it found one in five respondents said they were walking more often, while two in five reported cutting back on the number of trips they make altogether.

Lead author Dr Lauren Pearson from Monash University's School of Public Health and Preventive Medicine told SBS News that the findings reveal how rising fuel costs are reshaping daily life, but also highlight stark inequalities in who can adapt.

"The changes we're seeing, including more people choosing to walk for more of their trips, point to quite substantial latent demand, people wanting to use more active and sustainable modes of transport that are also more resilient to future fuel crises, which will happen again."

Pearson noted that many respondents were also open to using public transport (57 per cent), cycling (35 per cent) and e-bikes (27 per cent), but acknowledged that factors such as age, location, physical ability and access to alternative transport options were influencing people's ability to make the switch.

The study also found Australians experiencing financial hardship were significantly more likely to change their travel habits than those who were financially secure.

Among respondents facing financial pressures, 85 per cent reported altering the way they travel.

But 56 per cent of those who said they were not struggling financially reported altering their travel.

Experts say the findings point to a growing divide between Australians who have access to alternative transport options and those who remain heavily reliant on private vehicles.

body.en:
Forecasts showing a dire outcome for renters from the government's tax changes are being dismissed by Labor as the work of "vested interests".

Health Minister Mark Butler said it was hardly surprising the real estate lobby would defend the status quo after property industry groups released modelling claiming the impact of the tax package would be worse for rent prices and housing supply than Treasury forecasts.

The modelling, conducted by economic consultancies Qaive and Tulipwood and released jointly by the Real Estate Institute, Master Builders, and the Property Council, suggested the budget would cause 8,700 fewer new homes to be built over the next four years.

Rents would be $9 a week higher, Australia's economy would be $864 million smaller and there would be 3,800 fewer construction jobs than would otherwise be the case, the analysis suggests.

The modelling took into account changes to negative gearing and the capital gains tax discount, as well as $2 billion to fund enabling infrastructure and boost construction productivity, included in the budget.

The outcomes were significantly more pessimistic than Treasury's modelling, which found rents would only increase by $2 a week and housing supply would be 30,000 higher over a decade.

Much of the variance can be explained by different assumptions about the enabling infrastructure fund, which the property industry's modelling found would only result in 5,300 new homes over four years compared to Treasury's expectation of 26,000 new homes.

Butler said the government would back the modelling of Treasury officials, who were employed by the public to work in the public interest and "not in the interest of vested interests".

"I'm not sure people will be particularly shocked that the real estate industry, for example, is very happy with the status quo," he told Seven's Sunrise program on Friday.

"What a surprise that they've got some modelling that indicates the government should do absolutely nothing."

Butler cited forecasts from independent think tank the Grattan Institute, which estimated the changes would result in an increase in median rents of just $1 per week.

title.en: Is 'baby brain' real? Nearly 300 parents put the theory to the test
title.zh: “婴儿大脑”是真的吗？近 300 名家长对这一理论进行了测试

summary.en: Many new parents describe the mental fog of early parenthood as 'baby brain'. But Australian researchers found a surprise.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
'Baby brain' has long been used to describe feelings of forgetfulness and brain fog in new mums.

But a team of psychologists from Monash University have tested the memory of new parents — and they believe mums and dads are just as 'with it' as non-parents.

Co-author and PhD candidate at Monash University Navyaan Siddiqui said that for decades, 'baby brain' was used to stereotype new mums as "lesser".

"Becoming a parent is associated, especially in women, with these lapses in memory and cognitive decline," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The study recruited 290 new parents, and 100 non-parents, and put them through a series of tests looking at memory and executive function.

The new parents all had children no more than two years old. The tests included memorising a list of words to see how many a person could remember after twenty minutes.

"We expected parents would perform worse than non-parents on the cognitive tasks," Siddiqui said.

Siddiqui stressed that the findings don't mean that new parents struggling with the mental load of raising a baby were mistaken in feeling overwhelmed.

The cognitive capacity was the same, but "the capacity is being overwhelmed by the demands of parenthood itself".

Queensland Brain Institute associate professor Susannah Tye, who was not involved in the study, told SBS News, "a lot of things happen to women's brains" while pregnant.

Tye said that the hormones required to grow a new human impact brain cell volume and white matter, the "cells that protect the neurons in the brain".

Things like memory start to be affected when the stress of caring for a newborn collides with a lack of sleep.

"When the brain is under energetic stress, it doesn't get the chance to rest and repair and restock its batteries."

The Monash study showed that new fathers experience a decline in their self-reported memory.

This means that while their objective results were the same, many new fathers had lost confidence in how they were feeling more than any other group.

"It might indicate that dads are being affected by the experience of becoming a parent and all the barriers and things that come with it," Siddiqui said.

Clinical psychologist Chris Barnes told SBS News the findings coincide with the changing role of fathers.

"It's much more blurred than it used to be and much more non-traditional. They're much more involved in childcare and pick-up and drop-offs," she said.

The human brain can take on and mirror patterns of people close to them, so "biologically, the father can experience similar impacts through that".

body.en:
From regional Queensland to outer Melbourne, Defence sites across Australia are at the centre of a growing legal and environmental battle over PFAS 'forever chemicals' linked to the manufacturing company 3M.

The Labor government will seek $2 billion in damages in a legal case against 3M, which is considered the largest legal claim ever brought by the government.

"We are taking on 3M on behalf of the Australian people and the Australians that are affected," Assistant Defence Minister Peter Khalil said.

"Today's announcement demonstrates that this government will stand up for Australians and hold big companies to account."

PFAS refers to a large group of synthetic chemicals used worldwide in manufacturing since the 1950s for water resistance.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Their toxicity was recognised in recent decades, with PFOS, PFOA, and PFHxS identified as the most harmful. Although these substances were banned in Australia in 2025, their continued use in legacy fire-fighting practices still causes problems.

The government alleges the company withheld information, misrepresented the effects of one of its products, and gave false assurances about environmental impacts and disposal.

"3M has never manufactured PFAS in Australia and ceased sales of the products at issue in Australia around two decades ago," they said.

"Despite this, the Department of Defence continued to use PFAS-containing fire-fighting foams for nearly two decades longer, as noted in a recent legislative committee report.

The foams are no longer used by defence, but it says it has spent $1.3 billion removing them from 28 contaminated sites across the country and surrounding areas where locals have been impacted, and compensating affected people.

On its website, the Department of Defence lists 28 PFAS management sites that are "being investigated and managed". The department confirmed these are the sites key to the case against 3M.

The sites are located in almost every state and territory, with the majority located in NSW, Queensland, and Western Australia.

The ACT's base in Jervis Bay has been impacted, as well as three sites in the NT — the RAAF base Tindal, RAAF Base Darwin and Robertson Barracks.

title.en: Australians from hantavirus-hit cruise issued extended quarantine orders
title.zh: 来自受汉坦病毒袭击的游轮的澳大利亚人发布了延长隔离令

summary.en: The passengers have tested negative, but authorities say the risk of transmission after disembarkation has not passed.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A group of Australian residents and one New Zealander have had their quarantine period extended after being caught up in a deadly hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship.

Health Minister Mark Butler announced on Thursday the six people who have been in isolation at the Centre for National Resilience in Western Australia since mid-May will remain there for the full 42-day quarantine period, as recommended by Australian health officials and the World Health Organization.

"The passengers have been informed about the advice and the decision of government," Butler told reporters in Canberra.

"I'm happy to say they remain well, they've only been tested again in the last 24 or 36 hours or so and all six have again tested negative."

An order, made under the Biosecurity Act, has remained in place for three weeks and was extended ahead of its expiry date of 5 June.

About 23 countries whose citizens were also on the cruise have put in place a number of quarantine arrangements.

Butler said there have been two additional reports of hantavirus infections linked to the ship.

A crew member from the cruise ship in the Netherlands tested positive, along with a passenger in Spain.

This confirmed the risk of transmission after disembarkation has not passed, Butler said.

Earlier in May, a cluster of cruise ship passengers were reported to have contracted severe respiratory illnesses after it departed Argentina on 1 April.
